notes.title: Version 1.4.39 - changelist tweaked
Version 1.4.39 - changelist tweaked
Version 1.4.39 (not implemented yet)
notes.notes:
— New country feature — resource orders;
Amount of countries with planned economy have become smaller, and it's time to support them with new features. Please, tell us how do you imagine this tool and how do you want it to work.

— A new mode in the combat simulator — simulation of a battle by a city (with tactics and waves);
You have been asjing foe this mode for so long, and we have finally made it.

— Ground military exercises have been removed.
There is no need in it anymore with the new combat simulator mode.

— Amount of fortifications on the battlefield can now be taken into account in tactics rules.
Just another simple upgrade of tactics. We hope that it will be useful to you.

— Troops of different countries can't join the same military operation anymore.
A country will have more benefits than any kind of unions.

— Troops which are owned by less than 50% of country players have 15% military bonus penalty.
It has been made to remove benefits, when countries exchange players. Most likely there will be more changes of such kind in the next game versions.

Implementation date: late January.

notes.title: Battle system - a Big Update
notes.notes:
A big update of the battle system is being prepared for implementation.

Many aspects were improved and reworked, especially graphics, and also rebalanced.

No clear date for the patch is defined, but the update will be ready to be checked out in the combat simulators of all existing worlds soon! Tick the checkbox "New battle system" (if there is one).

As always, bug reports are appreciated.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/fa54cf91a2ddcd639e5772d09e9ab6e80bc53d47.png
